title: <tool> service status --json
description: SPEC §1 `status`: whether the service is installed, running and answering; the installed and running versions; the port, URL and pid; the unit's file; the log file; and warnings. A tool may add fields of its own.

running.description: The service manager says it's running.

installedVersion.description: The version of the CLI the unit runs, or null if not installed.

runningVersion.description: The version /api/health reports, or null if nothing answers.

unit.description: The unit's file: a .plist or .service path.

warnings.description: A stale unit, a missing Node, …

busy.description: What /api/busy said, if the tool asked it.

update.description: What the last `update --check` or `doctor` found, from <home>/update-check.json. `service status` never asks the registry itself.
